entries.text: Doris keeps FULL OUTER JOIN instead of emulating it with a UNION that split global aggregates into two rows, loads empty TPC-DS fields as NULL instead of empty strings, adds integer day offsets to date columns with DATE_ADD and DATE_SUB, and emits the grand-total row for ROLLUP over empty input, so the TPC-DS queries 97, 46, 68, 72 and 18 return the same rows as DuckDB.
